Bed.name: Medical Bed
Bed.description: A three-by-five powered sickbay bed, {0} kg. Lay an unconscious casualty in it, let the injured rest in it awake, or sleep in it. While powered and in a pressurised room it keeps a patient recuperating, drawing {1} kW while it does. Without power it is an ordinary bed. A drawer at the head holds dressings, splints and medicines.

Panel.help: Lay an unconscious casualty here while dragging them, or order an injured crew member to Rest and recover. Anyone tired may Sleep here unless you keep the bed for the injured. While powered and in air, the patient recuperates with the game's own medical-rest healing; cut the power and that stops until it returns. A resting patient gets up once their injuries have eased.
